meta.title: Check-Di · Multi-stage Supply Chain Traceability
meta.description: Check-Di tracks the product journey from origin to retail using timelines, QR codes, AI document cross-checking, and hash-based integrity proofs.

hero.description: Check-Di records each stage of a product batch. Buyers simply scan a QR code to see where the product has traveled, who verified it, and verify that the data remains intact.
hero.mobileDescription: AI checks it. The map shows the journey.
hero.mobileScanHint: AI cross-checks the batch right after the scan.
hero.routeSummary: Journey from Dak Lak to Ho Chi Minh City

gettingStarted.title: New to Check-Di? Follow the right next step.
gettingStarted.description: You do not need to understand blockchain first. Organizations can complete sign-in, wallet linking and batch creation in order. Consumers can scan a QR immediately without an account.
gettingStarted.organizationHint: Check-Di detects your current state and highlights the next action you should take.

steps.title: Sign in to your organization
steps.text: Use an account with an organization membership to enter the correct workspace.

steps.title: Link a Phantom wallet
steps.text: Verify the wallet representing your organization so it can sign data and Registry transactions on Solana Devnet.

steps.title: Create your first batch
steps.text: Enter the batch code, product and origin, then add each supply-chain stage with its supporting documents.

steps.title: Confirm and share the QR
steps.text: AI cross-checks the data, the organization signs the stage, and consumers can then review the journey and proof from the QR.

gettingStarted.consumerTitle: Just want to verify a product?
gettingStarted.consumerText: No sign-in and no wallet required. Consumers can scan a QR or open the sample batch to review the full trace.
consumerSteps: Scan the QR or open a batch code
Review timeline, locations and AI checks
Check the confirming organization, hash and proof
gettingStarted.consumerNote: The public verification flow does not require Phantom.

coreFlow.title: Like parcel tracking, but for product authenticity.
coreFlow.description: Each stage leaves an independently verifiable trace instead of a single static QR label linking to unverified claims.

steps.title: Each party records their stage
steps.text: Growers, packaging facilities, inspection hubs, logistics carriers, and retailers update batch data at handoff points.

steps.title: AI cross-checks documents
steps.text: AI parses inspection sheets, packing lists, invoices and flags discrepancies in dates, weights, or batch IDs.

steps.title: Data is hashed for integrity
steps.text: Once the stakeholder confirms, the stage payload is canonicalized and hashed to ensure tamper-evident records.

steps.title: Consumers scan the QR code
steps.text: The verification page displays the full timeline, geo-locations, certifying parties, and integrity status.

dualTrack.badge: One QR Code · Shared Stakeholder Accountability
dualTrack.title: No single party controls the entire narrative.
dualTrack.description: Each organization only confirms data for its own segment of the chain. Check-Di links these checkpoints into a verifiable timeline for consumers.

groups.title: Producers / Orchards
groups.text: Initialize batch records, register harvest parameters, and attach origin certificates.

groups.title: Packaging & Quality Control
groups.text: Append inspection certificates, grading results, and sign off on processed quantities.

groups.title: Logistics & Warehousing
groups.text: Log dispatch and delivery timestamps, route conditions, and custody handoffs.

groups.title: Retailers & Consumers

dualTrack.competitionBanner: For UniHackFest, Technical Build proves AI document verification + hash integrity + QR scanning + Solana anchoring; Product & Business demonstrates real-world supply chain feasibility and stakeholder adoption. Both tracks share the same Check-Di core.

architecture.title: Blockchain does not replace real data. It guarantees historical integrity.
architecture.description: Detailed documents and high-volume data remain off-chain. Each stage produces a canonicalized hash; Solana serves as the public layer verifying the hash, signing entity, timestamp, and status.
architecture.demoDisclaimer: The hashes shown above are sample data. The Solana program is not yet deployed on-chain in this milestone.
architecture.offChainText: Certificates, high-res photos, exact warehouse addresses, and editable enterprise files remain stored off-chain.
architecture.onChainText: Batch/stage hashes, certifier public keys, schema versions, timestamps, and active status are anchored on-chain.
architecture.immutabilityText: If confirmed data is altered, existing hashes no longer match. The system must register a superseded version rather than quietly overwriting history.

compliance.title: Transparent integrity without crypto speculation.
compliance.description: Check-Di uses blockchain strictly as an integrity proof layer, not as a financial trading system.
rules: No raw or confidential documents stored on-chain
No tokens, no speculative investments, no crypto payments
AI highlights discrepancies without making automated fraud verdicts
Each party only verifies records within their direct custody
